name: Hound
description: A deadly sharpshooter and tracker. XP trigger: You addressed a challenge with tracking or violence.

features.name: Sharpshooter
features.description: You can push yourself to do one of the following: make a ranged attack at extreme distance beyond what's normal for the weapon -- unleash a barrage of rapid fire to suppress the enemy.

features.name: Focused
features.description: You may expend your special armor to resist a consequence of surprise or mental harm (fear, confusion, losing track of someone) or to push yourself for ranged combat or tracking.

features.name: Ghost Hunter
features.description: Your hunting pet is imbued with spirit energy. It gains potency when tracking or fighting the supernatural, and gains an arcane ability: ghost-form, mind-link, or arrow-swift. Take this ability again to choose an additional arcane ability for your pet.

features.name: Scout
features.description: When you gather info to locate a target, you get +1 effect. When you hide in a prepared position or use camouflage, you get +1d to rolls to avoid detection.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: From hard won experience or occult ritual, you are immune to the poisonous miasma of the deathlands and are able to subsist on the strange flora and fauna there. You get +1 stress box.

features.name: Tough as Nails
features.description: Penalties from harm are one level less severe (though level 4 harm is still fatal).

features.name: Vengeful
features.description: You gain an additional xp trigger: You got payback against someone who harmed you or someone you care about. If your crew helped you get payback, also mark crew xp.

features.name: Veteran
features.description: Choose a special ability from another source.
